page_subtitle: Chat directly with shoppers on WhatsApp from any page of your store.
cache_notice: Changes can take up to a minute to show on pages that visitors have already loaded.
connect_subtitle: Set up your WhatsApp business or personal phone number.
enable_description: When enabled, visitors can open WhatsApp directly to chat with you.
phone_hint: Enter your Algerian mobile number (05/06/07) or international number with country code.
phone_invalid_reason: Invalid number: must be an Algerian mobile or international E.164 number
identity_subtitle: Personalise how your store appears in the chat prompt.
avatar_hint: Square image, recommended 100x100px. If empty, the store logo or icon is used.
caption_placeholder: e.g. Typically replies in a few minutes
message_subtitle: Configure greeting texts and shopper prefill templates.
welcome_placeholder: e.g. Hello! How can we help you today?
welcome_hint: Displayed inside the widget popup before the visitor clicks to chat.
launcher_placeholder: e.g. Chat with us (leave empty for icon only)
prefill_general_placeholder: e.g. Hello {store}, I have a question about your products.
prefill_product_placeholder: e.g. Hello, I am interested in {product} ({url}). Is it in stock?
thank_you_page_subtitle: Display an inline WhatsApp button in the order confirmation card.
prefill_thank_you_placeholder: e.g. Hello {store}, I placed order {order}. Please confirm it.
default_welcome: Hello! 👋 How can we help you today?
default_prefill_general: Hello, I have a question about your store
default_prefill_product: Hello, I'd like to ask about {product} — {url}
default_prefill_thank_you: Hello {store}, I placed order {order}. Please confirm it.
tokens_hint: Click a token to insert into template:
surfaces_subtitle: Choose which pages display the WhatsApp chat button.
surface_product_hint: Individual product pages with product details.
surface_pages_hint: About, policy, contact, and terms pages.
surface_thank_you_hint: Thank you page shown right after placing an order.
surface_checkout_hint: Off by default — keeping checkout free of distractions reduces abandoned orders.
surface_landing_hint: Off by default — landing page ad funnels usually convert best with a single focused CTA.
surfaces_all_off_warning: All surfaces are disabled. The widget will not appear on your store until at least one page is enabled.
look_subtitle: Customise the widget colours, screen position and animations.
attention_hint: Gently animates the button after 8 seconds of inactivity to catch shopper attention.
phone_required: Enter a WhatsApp phone number before enabling.
phone_invalid: The WhatsApp phone number is not valid.
prefill_general_too_long: General message template exceeds maximum characters.
prefill_product_too_long: Product message template exceeds maximum characters.
thank_you_button_label_too_long: Thank-you button label exceeds maximum characters.
prefill_thank_you_too_long: Thank-you message template exceeds maximum characters.
load_failed: Could not load WhatsApp widget settings.
save_failed: Could not save WhatsApp widget settings.
